title: Equipment order dispute — escalated
body: This is regarding my $1,450.00 order of photography lighting equipment from Oct 8. I first contacted the seller Oct 15, then again Oct 22. They claimed it shipped Oct 10, then said Oct 18, then gave me a tracking number that doesn't work. I have also filed a chargeback with my card issuer because I don't trust this process. I expect PayPal to rule in my favor given the seller's contradictory statements.
